intent: Deterministic, data-driven schema for the next adventure-map activity layer beyond windmill/quarry/shrine. Mirrors the existing FSoulHeartlandSite + HeartlandDevelopment.json pattern so Codex can extend the single campaign authority (USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem) additively rather than build a second site/quest system.
non_goals: No second Save authority (extend the existing Soul.Campaign RBSave domain, schema 1).
No second combat/diplomacy authority (route all resolution through the existing campaign battle bridge and SoulDiplomacyRules).
No invented /Game paths or asset ownership (all presentation is gameplay-only until a LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK admits an owned mesh).
No geography redesign (uses the existing 36-region soul_world_overmap region ids verbatim).
Do not reopen Human Capital replacement, Titan/R10, terrain bakeoffs.

verified_current_anchors.label: VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT
verified_current_anchors.site_struct: FSoulHeartlandSite in Source/Soul/Public/SoulHeartlandContent.h (fields: Id, Region, Effect, Name, Amount, ActionCost).
verified_current_anchors.site_loader: FSoulHeartlandContent::Load in Source/Soul/Private/SoulHeartlandContent.cpp (reads Data/SettlementEnvironments/HeartlandDevelopment.json 'sites' array; validates Effect in {gold,mana}, Amount>=1, ActionCost>=1).
verified_current_anchors.site_collection: USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::InteractHeartlandSite (Source/Soul/Private/SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp:983) with per-day throttle TMap<FName,int32> HeartlandSiteDays (header line 109).
verified_current_anchors.world_model: FSoulRegionState/FSoulWorldState in Source/SoulCore/Public/SoulWorld.h (Id, OwnerFactionId, Biome, Landform, Feature, Neighbors, RoadNeighbors, ApproachFromNeighbor, bSettlement). No coordinate field at runtime; (x,y) is data-only.
verified_current_anchors.region_data: 36 regions in Data/soul_world_overmap_v1_20260922.json 'nodes'; ownership/neutral overlay in Data/soul_campaign_start_states_v1_20260922.json scenario six_faction_sandbox_candidate (neutral_regions[24], value_site_candidates, neutral_minor_sites, region_control control_class).
verified_current_anchors.rng_convention: FRandomStream seeded from FCrc::StrCrc32(*Id.ToString()) (e.g. SoulCampaignTerrain.cpp:1019); permille rolls via Rng.RandRange(0,999) (SoulCombat).
verified_current_anchors.save_domain: URBSaveSubsystem / IRBSaveDomainProvider domain 'Soul.Campaign' schema 1. Additive capture at SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp:717 (heartland_* fields incl. heartland_site_days), restore at line 843.
verified_current_anchors.diplomacy: FSoulDiplomacyRules + subsystem TMap<FName,FSoulDiplomaticRelation> HumanRelations (RelationPermille, Stance War/Peace/NonAggression).
verified_current_anchors.memory: FSoulMemoryRules::RecordPlaceLoss / PlaceReclaimBonus keyed on PlaceId (region/site id); commanders only, per AGENTS.md.
verified_current_anchors.ai: FSoulStrategyAI::Choose over FSoulStrategicRegion.ResourceValue + ESoulStrategyAction {Hold,Recover,DefendOwnedRegion,CaptureResourceRegion,AttackVisibleArmy,SeizeExposedRegion,SiegeSettlement}. AI has NO awareness of Heartland sites today.

id_conventions.activity_kind_id: activity.<kind>  e.g. activity.watchtower (a kind/template id, distinct from an instance id)
id_conventions.region_id: existing snake_case region ids from soul_world_overmap nodes ONLY (never invented).
id_conventions.note: Mirrors existing dot-namespaced content ids (heartland.windmill, human.tavern, Magic.Spell.Ice.Blizzard).

activity_kind.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
activity_kind.notes: windmill/quarry are 'resource_node'; existing shrine maps to 'shrine'. Three current Heartland sites remain under their current authority and are re-expressed here only for continuity, not re-authored.

state_machine.dormant: defined but not yet discoverable (fog / prerequisite not met).
state_machine.contested: occupied by a hostile neutral garrison or monster den; requires a battle before interaction.
state_machine.cleared: hostile occupant removed; one-shot sites become 'depleted' after reward is taken.
state_machine.depleted: one-shot reward already taken; no further benefit (persists in save).
state_machine.exhausted_today: recurring site already collected this campaign Day (mirrors HeartlandSiteDays throttle).

interaction_mode.notes: collect == existing InteractHeartlandSite flow. clear_then_collect routes through the existing campaign battle bridge first.

reward_kind.label_note: Only gold and mana are VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT as site effects. All other reward_kind values are DESIGN PROPOSAL and require the named systems (recruitment pools exist in FSoulCampaignEconomy.RecruitmentPools; hero xp exists on FSoulHeroState; relic_item has NO owning item authority yet -> LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED before admitting).

risk_class.mapping_to_combat: risk_class only sizes the hostile occupant for clear_then_collect / intercept; actual resolution uses the existing battle bridge, never a synthetic combat model.

activity_site_definition.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
activity_site_definition.description: Authoring record for one map-activity instance. Superset of FSoulHeartlandSite: every existing field is preserved so the current three sites remain expressible; new fields are additive and default to inert values so old data loads unchanged.

region.constraint: MUST be an existing soul_world_overmap node id.

action_cost.note: 0 allowed for pure escort/combat triggers that spend movement elsewhere.

recurring.note: true -> uses the per-day throttle like current sites; false -> one-shot, becomes 'depleted'.

resource_id.note: key into FSoulCampaignEconomy.Resources; only 'gold' is live today.

payload_id.note: for relic_item/recruitment_pool/spell unlock; null until an owning authority admits it.

occupant_faction.note: NAME_None style neutral; sizes the clear battle via existing bridge.

requires_region_owned.note: mirrors current InteractHeartlandSite ownership gate; false for neutral/clear sites.

window_days.note: null = permanent; integer = time-limited (caravan/convoy/event) -> state 'expired' after.

resource_value_bonus.note: added to FSoulStrategicRegion.ResourceValue for the hosting region.

place_id.note: defaults to region id; drives FSoulMemoryRules::PlaceReclaimBonus.

presentation.label_note: GAMEPLAY-ONLY until a LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK admits an owned mesh. No /Game path is asserted here.

candidate_owned_pack.note: VERIFIED OWNED ASSET METADATA reference only; see owned_asset_candidates.json. Never a /Game path.

backward_compat.statement: An existing FSoulHeartlandSite {Id,Region,Effect,Name,Amount,ActionCost} is exactly: {id:Id, kind:'resource_node'|'shrine', region:Region, name:Name, interaction:'collect', action_cost:ActionCost, recurring:true, reward:{kind:Effect, amount:Amount, resource_id:'gold'}}. The loader can keep reading the three Heartland sites unchanged and additionally read an 'activities' array; no existing data is rewritten.

persistence_contract.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL (extends VERIFIED save authority)

additive_fields.activity_site_days: TMap<FName,int32> (site id -> last-collected Day). EXACT mirror of existing heartland_site_days serialization pattern (IntMap, validate value<=Day and id known).
additive_fields.activity_site_states: TMap<FName,uint8> (site id -> activity_state). Only persist non-default (not 'available'); absent key = default. Tolerant restore.
additive_fields.quest_progress: TMap<FName,int32> (quest id -> step index). Absent = not started.
additive_fields.campaign_event_seed: int32, default 1701 analogue (reuse the existing AlphaSeed precedent; persisted and validated <= 1,000,000).
additive_fields.fired_events_by_day: optional ring/log TMap<FName,int32> for anti-spam dedupe (event id -> last fired Day).

persistence_contract.rule: Add these inside the existing CaptureRBSaveDomain_Implementation (SoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem.cpp:717 region) and RestoreRBSaveDomain_Implementation (line 843 region). Keep SchemaVersion==1 and tolerant of missing keys so pre-feature saves load. Do NOT register a new IRBSaveDomainProvider.

determinism_contract.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL
determinism_contract.rationale: Combines a stable content id (per RNG convention at SoulCampaignTerrain.cpp:1019), a persisted campaign seed, and the current Day so results are reproducible across save/load and identical across machines.
determinism_contract.tie_breaks: On equal scores, order by stable id (FNameLexicalLess) then by region id, matching the stable tie-break rule in AGENTS.md.
determinism_contract.no_spam_rule: At most N events may be eligible per Day (default N=1 at start of campaign, scaling with owned-region count). Eligibility is evaluated once per AdvanceDay after FSoulCampaignRules::AdvanceDay increments Day; fired_events_by_day prevents re-fire.

integration_points.label: DESIGN PROPOSAL (targets are VERIFIED anchors)
integration_points.data_load: Extend FSoulHeartlandContent::Load (or add a sibling loader FSoulActivityContent::Load) to read an 'activities' array and an event pool file; reuse the subsystem ReadData(RelativePath,OutJson) helper.
integration_points.collection: Generalize USoulFounderPlaytestStateSubsystem::InteractHeartlandSite into InteractActivitySite(FName SiteId, FString& Msg): same gating lambda pattern, switch on interaction mode (collect == current path; clear_then_collect raises a battle via the existing bridge before reward).
integration_points.tick: Insert EvaluateStrategicEvents(Rng) call inside AdvanceDay() immediately after FSoulCampaignRules::AdvanceDay(Economy) and before AdvanceEnemyAI(); gated by bHeartlandEnabled || bSixFactionProfile.
integration_points.ai: After event evaluation, apply activity ai_interest.resource_value_bonus onto the FSoulStrategicRegion.ResourceValue the strategy snapshot builds (see ai_site_interest.md).
integration_points.diplomacy: War/trader/refugee events call FSoulDiplomacyRules::Apply or nudge RelationPermille on an entry of HumanRelations.
integration_points.memory: Site-loss / reclaim events call FSoulMemoryRules::RecordPlaceLoss / read PlaceReclaimBonus with PlaceId = region id.

explicit_unknowns: LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED: whether any owned ruin/tower/cave/den mesh is actually imported into the Soul.uproject /Game tree (catalog shows Imported:false for all; imported_unreal_summary.json is for a DIFFERENT project).

LOCAL RUNTIME-ASSET CHECK REQUIRED: whether neutral/monster occupant stacks can be instantiated through the existing battle bridge without a new combat authority (bridge accepts a FSoulCampaignBattleDescriptor; occupant roster source is unverified).
DESIGN PROPOSAL unknown: there is NO item/relic authority in the snapshot, so reward_kind:relic_item cannot be admitted until one exists (coordinate with hero/economy lanes).
BALANCE_PENDING: all amounts, risk strengths, event probabilities, and window_days are placeholders pending Lane 9 economy model.
